description: Source code for 'iossim', an executable that runs an app in the iOS Simulator, handling simulator session management, output redirection, and environment setup.

classes.name: SimulatorDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class managing the output of the simulated app, handling output tailing, session start/end events, and error logging.

methods.name: initWithStdioPath:developerDir:
methods.description: Initializes the delegate with paths for stdio and developer directory.

methods.name: tailOutput
methods.description: Continuously reads simulated app output and writes it to stdout.

methods.name: localizedSimulatorErrorString:
methods.description: Fetches localized error message from simulator bundle.

methods.name: session:didStart:withError:
methods.description: Handles the start of a simulator session, starts output tailing, or logs errors if startup fails.

methods.name: session:didEndWithError:
methods.description: Handles the end of a simulator session, checks for errors or crashes, and logs system messages.
